messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Overview** | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates).
• “No Speed Limit” zones exist on some rural highways; drivers must use caution. | | **Seat Belt & Child Restraint** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **DUI / DWI** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) limit is 0.08% for drivers over 21.
• Zero tolerance for BAC ≥ 0.02% for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | | **Texting & Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles approaching from the right have priority.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | | **Lane Discipline** | • Drivers must stay in their lane unless turning or passing.
• Lane changes require signaling and checking mirrors. | | **School Bus** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | | **Parking** | • No parking within 20 ft of a fire hydrant.
• Parking in a handicap space requires a valid permit. | | **Towing & Vehicle Registration** | • Vehicles must display a valid registration sticker.
• Towing regulations apply to commercial vehicles. | ### Where to Find Official Information - **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – [https://www.dps.texas.gov/](https://www.dps.texas.gov/) - **Texas Transportation Code** – Available online through the Texas Legislature’s website. - **Local County Courts** – For specific traffic violations and penalties. ### Common Traffic Violations & Penalties | Violation | Typical Penalty | |-----------|-----------------| | Speeding | Fines ranging from $50–$500; points added to license | | Seat Belt Non‑Compliance | Fine up to $200 | | DUI | Fines, license suspension, mandatory alcohol education | | Texting While Driving | Fine up to $200 | | Illegal Parking | Fine up to $200 | --- **Tip:** If you’re unsure about a specific law or need legal advice, consult a licensed attorney or the Texas DPS.
